# Topic: Vossloh Group

New locomotive leasing company Nexrail joins EU market

Nexrail will focus on providing innovative, sustainable locomotives for non-electrified operations, and is currently dedicated to the freight and shunting markets. It has purchased 53 shunting locomotives, and ordered another 50 hybrid locomotives from Vossloh.](https://www.railwaygazette.com/infrastructure/2021/09/16/new-locomotive-leasing-company-nexrail-joins-eu-market/) ![

Vossloh to supply switches and crossings in Norway

Railway supplier Vossloh has won a contract for equipping the Norwegian rail network with switches and crossings for Bane NOR. Deliveries will run until 2029. International railway supplier Vossloh has taken over the Dutch ETS Spoor. With the acquisition, the company wants to expand its position on the Dutch rail market.](https://www.railwaygazette.com/policy/2021/07/27/vossloh-takes-over-dutch-ets-spoor/)![
